She is in a bright indoor room with white brick walls and window curtains. Yellow variety-style text overlays appear over her as she gestures with her hands. (2) The scene shifts to a full-body shot of the woman standing in the same room. She points upwards and gestures with four fingers to emphasize counts. Beside her is a wooden table with small animal figurines. The lighting is bright and natural. (3) A sequence of screen recordings shows a mobile phone interface. The user navigates a registration form on the FarEasTone (遠傳) website, entering personal details for an iPhone 17 pre-order. A large QR code appears in the top right corner. (4) The woman returns to a tight close-up, whispering into the camera with her hand partially covering her mouth. She looks directly at the viewer with wide eyes, suggesting a secret. Yellow text emphasizing the "hidden discount" appears below her. (5) Another screen recording shows a "SurveyCake" success page with a cartoon cat and a discount voucher of NT$500. The woman is briefly seen in a small inset or cutaway, continuing her explanation. (6) The woman is shown lying on a beige sofa, laughing as a large, grey seal-shaped plushie is tossed onto her. She interacts with the plushie while continuing to talk. The background includes a large potted plant and a bookshelf. (7) She sits at a wooden desk in a well-lit studio-like setting, speaking calmly. Behind her is a shelf with a framed picture and a wooden mannequin. She holds her phone and demonstrates its use. (8) A final summary screen appears, displaying detailed text about credit card offers and installment plans over a blurred image of the woman sitting on the sofa.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic, and energetic greeting. She speaks rapidly and clearly in Traditional Chinese. Background music consists of a steady, upbeat electronic pop track with a synthesized bassline and drum machine rhythm at approximately 124 BPM. (2) As the screen recording starts, a series of soft digital 'click' and 'whoosh' sound effects punctuate the transitions between UI steps. The vocal tone becomes instructional, maintaining a professional but friendly resonance. (3) The speaker's volume and pitch drop significantly into a staged whisper, creating a sense of secrecy. The background music remains constant but feels more prominent as the vocal intensity ducks. (4) A soft 'thud' and the rustle of fabric are heard as a plushie interacts with the speaker. Her voice rises in pitch and arousal, laughing briefly while maintaining the narrative flow. (5) The audio concludes with a summary delivery, where the voice is projected and clear. The electronic music track loops smoothly under the speech, fading out precisely as the final promotional details are listed.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the iPhone 17 pre-order services provided by FarEasTone (遠傳) in Taiwan. It uses a high-energy influencer-style presentation to walk users through the online registration process, highlighting exclusive benefits like coupons, installment plans, and in-store support.
